roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.scope: Data pipelines, warehouse modelling, data quality and operations.

roles.name: AI Engineer
roles.scope: Building, evaluating and deploying ML models; GenAI and LLM specialisation are excluded.

roles.name: Full-stack Developer
roles.scope: Web interfaces, application services, data and integration without a prescribed framework.

roles.name: Software Tester
roles.scope: Manual and automated functional testing, integration testing and basic performance testing.

levels.context: Complete bounded tasks with guidance and review.

levels.name: Middle
levels.context: Deliver and troubleshoot routine production work independently.

levels.name: Senior
levels.context: Resolve complex cross-component problems, justify trade-offs and review the work of others.

competencies.name: Data modelling and storage
competencies.outcomeStatement: Build a small data model and warehouse structure from supplied requirements.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Model constraints match sample data; document metadata and affected consumers.

competencies.name: Data pipeline implementation and integration
competencies.outcomeStatement: Implement a small data flow from an existing design.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Run extraction and transformations; verify mappings and safe task retries.

competencies.name: Data quality and operations
competencies.outcomeStatement: Check data quality and record operational issues under guidance.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Provide profiling results, pipeline tests, handling controls and execution logs.

competencies.name: Data modelling and storage
competencies.outcomeStatement: Design a data model supporting several consumers.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Explain modelling choices and demonstrate workload and dependency checks.

competencies.name: Data pipeline implementation and integration
competencies.outcomeStatement: Independently implement an integrated data pipeline.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Demonstrate correct outputs and recovery from expected task failures.

competencies.name: Data quality and operations
competencies.outcomeStatement: Investigate data failures across a pipeline.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Trace causes, verify fixes and demonstrate appropriate data access controls.

competencies.name: Data modelling and storage
competencies.outcomeStatement: Review data designs across domains and recommend improvements.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Compare alternative designs and substantiate performance and change-impact decisions.

competencies.name: Data pipeline implementation and integration
competencies.outcomeStatement: Design a complex pipeline and justify its operational approach.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Compare integration alternatives and demonstrate a scalable, retry-safe design.

competencies.name: Data quality and operations
competencies.outcomeStatement: Define quality controls and monitoring for a data solution.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Evaluate control effectiveness and justify testing and incident-response improvements.

competencies.name: ML data preparation
competencies.outcomeStatement: Prepare modelling data using an established procedure.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Document split and preprocessing decisions; inspect class balance and exclude leakage.

competencies.name: Model development and evaluation
competencies.outcomeStatement: Train and evaluate a baseline for a defined ML task.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Provide validation results, bounded parameter experiments and an error summary.

competencies.name: Model deployment and operations
competencies.outcomeStatement: Package a model and run a guided integration trial.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Reload the artifact, reproduce the environment and demonstrate contract checks.

competencies.name: ML data preparation
competencies.outcomeStatement: Design preprocessing and feature preparation for a modelling task.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce transformations and justify split and imbalance evaluation choices.

competencies.name: Model development and evaluation
competencies.outcomeStatement: Compare models and select one against the problem objective.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Use a consistent validation protocol and justify tuning and error trade-offs.

competencies.name: Model deployment and operations
competencies.outcomeStatement: Integrate a model and maintain its operational workflow.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Provide monitoring evidence, reproducible runs and a tested maintenance procedure.

competencies.name: ML data preparation
competencies.outcomeStatement: Review the data preparation approach for an ML solution.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Identify leakage or sampling risks and verify the chosen mitigations.

competencies.name: Model development and evaluation
competencies.outcomeStatement: Design model evaluation to support an adoption decision.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Assess alternatives, failure patterns and limitations before recommending a model.

competencies.name: Model deployment and operations
competencies.outcomeStatement: Design model operations and response to performance deterioration.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Justify integration and maintenance choices and verify changes before release.

competencies.name: Web interface development
competencies.outcomeStatement: Build a web interface from supplied requirements.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Demonstrate semantic layout, responsive behaviour, accessible interaction and request error handling.

competencies.name: Application services and data
competencies.outcomeStatement: Implement a small service and data interaction.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Verify contracts, input checks, permissions and transaction behaviour.

competencies.name: Software quality and delivery
competencies.outcomeStatement: Fix a bounded defect and add tests within an existing workflow.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce the issue, check the change, review the code and run CI.

competencies.name: Web interface development
competencies.outcomeStatement: Independently implement a usable web interface.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Explain interface decisions and resolve accessibility, layout and asynchronous state defects.

competencies.name: Application services and data
competencies.outcomeStatement: Integrate interface, services and storage into a complete feature.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Demonstrate cross-layer error handling, authorization and consistent updates.

competencies.name: Software quality and delivery
competencies.outcomeStatement: Test and review changes across a complete feature.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Provide regression evidence and justified implementation improvements.

competencies.name: Web interface development
competencies.outcomeStatement: Review interface solutions and guide improvements.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Support design recommendations with user-flow evidence and accessibility checks.

competencies.name: Application services and data
competencies.outcomeStatement: Design complex service integration and justify trade-offs.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Review interfaces and failure modes with evidence for security and data consistency.

competencies.name: Software quality and delivery
competencies.outcomeStatement: Lead technical review and improve delivery quality.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Explain review decisions and demonstrate more reliable code and integration checks.

competencies.name: Test design and planning
competencies.outcomeStatement: Derive test cases from supplied requirements with guidance.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Include representative partitions, boundaries and initial risk priorities.

competencies.name: Test execution and defect evidence
competencies.outcomeStatement: Run tests and report reproducible defects.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Record test data, environment, expected results, observed failures and impact.

competencies.name: Test automation and integration
competencies.outcomeStatement: Add automated checks using an existing structure.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Demonstrate assertions, repeatability, a guided workload test and flaky-result investigation.

competencies.name: Test design and planning
competencies.outcomeStatement: Design a risk-based test suite and exploratory activities.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Trace tests to requirements and justify selected cases and priorities.

competencies.name: Test execution and defect evidence
competencies.outcomeStatement: Investigate defects and communicate test consequences.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Provide reproducible evidence, retest results and regression findings.

competencies.name: Test automation and integration
competencies.outcomeStatement: Build automated checks for component interactions.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Provide reliable integration tests and interpretable workload measurements.

competencies.name: Test design and planning
competencies.outcomeStatement: Review team test scope and priorities.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Explain coverage gaps, risk choices and improvements to the test approach.

competencies.name: Test execution and defect evidence
competencies.outcomeStatement: Synthesize test evidence for a release decision.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: State remaining defects, product impact and the limits of available test evidence.

competencies.name: Test automation and integration
competencies.outcomeStatement: Design an automation approach for a team.
competencies.acceptanceCriteria: Evaluate maintainability, flakiness and performance coverage and verify improvements.

skills.name: create data models
skills.definition: Represent entities, relationships and constraints in a data model.

skills.name: develop data processing applications
skills.definition: Implement programs that transform input data into specified outputs.

skills.name: implement data warehousing techniques
skills.definition: Apply warehouse structures and loading techniques to analytical data.

skills.name: Document source-to-target mappings
skills.definition: Record how source fields become target fields, including transformation rules.

skills.name: Verify data quality
skills.definition: Check records against explicit completeness, accuracy and consistency rules.

skills.name: Maintain metadata documentation
skills.definition: Record dataset meaning, ownership and structural metadata.

skills.name: Monitor pipeline operations
skills.definition: Observe pipeline runs and investigate operational failures.

skills.name: Design data integration flows
skills.definition: Specify how data moves between source and destination systems.

skills.name: create data sets
skills.definition: Assemble a dataset suitable for a stated modelling task.

skills.name: Prepare leakage-safe training data
skills.definition: Fit preprocessing on training data without leaking evaluation information.

skills.name: Construct and select model features
skills.definition: Build or select input features relevant to the prediction task.

skills.name: utilise machine learning
skills.definition: Apply a suitable machine learning method to a defined problem.

skills.name: build predictive models
skills.definition: Train a predictive model from an identified dataset.

skills.name: Evaluate predictive models
skills.definition: Compare predictions with reference outcomes using appropriate metrics.

skills.name: Package and deploy a model
skills.definition: Save, load and expose a model in a reproducible runtime.

skills.name: Monitor deployed model performance
skills.definition: Track deployed model quality and operational behaviour.

skills.name: design user interface
skills.definition: Specify user interface structure and interactions for a user task.

skills.name: Implement accessible user interfaces
skills.definition: Implement interfaces that support keyboard and assistive technology use.

skills.name: design application interfaces
skills.definition: Define interfaces through which application components exchange information.

skills.name: use query languages
skills.definition: Retrieve and manipulate data using a query language.

skills.name: integrate system components
skills.definition: Connect components and verify their combined behaviour.

skills.name: debug software
skills.definition: Locate and correct causes of software defects.

skills.name: perform software unit testing
skills.definition: Verify individual units of software with repeatable automated checks.

skills.name: conduct ICT code review
skills.definition: Review source changes and give actionable technical feedback.

skills.name: plan software testing
skills.definition: Set test scope, approach, resources and completion conditions.

skills.name: develop ICT test suite
skills.definition: Organise test cases into a suite linked to intended behaviours.

skills.name: execute software tests
skills.definition: Run specified tests and record observed results.

skills.name: report test findings
skills.definition: Communicate test results and defects with supporting evidence.

skills.name: replicate customer software issues
skills.definition: Reproduce a reported issue under identified conditions.

skills.name: develop automated software tests
skills.definition: Implement repeatable automated tests with meaningful assertions.

skills.name: execute integration testing
skills.definition: Test interactions and data exchange between components.

skills.name: Perform structured exploratory testing
skills.definition: Investigate software using a defined exploratory testing charter.

skills.name: Profile source datasets
skills.definition: Summarise missing values, duplicates and distributions before ingestion.

skills.name: Implement data extraction
skills.definition: Extract source records into a controlled staging area.

skills.name: Implement transformation rules
skills.definition: Convert values and enforce business rules during data processing.

skills.name: Orchestrate retry-safe pipeline tasks
skills.definition: Order dependent tasks and make retries preserve correct outputs.

skills.name: Optimise warehouse workloads
skills.definition: Compare access speed and loading cost before selecting a warehouse optimisation.

skills.name: Apply secure data handling
skills.definition: Apply access restrictions and approved handling controls to datasets.

skills.name: Test data pipelines
skills.definition: Write checks for transformation logic and end-to-end data flow.

skills.name: Trace data dependencies
skills.definition: Identify downstream consumers affected by a dataset change.

skills.name: Select data split strategies
skills.definition: Choose random, stratified, grouped or temporal splits to match the data.

skills.name: Run cross-validation
skills.definition: Evaluate a training procedure across valid folds without contaminating the final test set.

skills.name: Tune model hyperparameters
skills.definition: Search candidate settings using validation evidence and a bounded budget.

skills.name: Assess class imbalance
skills.definition: Inspect class frequencies and choose evaluation measures that reveal minority-class errors.

skills.name: Analyse model errors
skills.definition: Inspect confusion patterns or residuals to explain model weaknesses.

skills.name: Reproduce ML experiments
skills.definition: Record split seeds, parameters and environment assumptions for repeatable runs.

skills.name: Test model service integration
skills.definition: Verify prediction input/output contracts within the consuming system.

skills.name: Plan model maintenance
skills.definition: Define retraining and revalidation steps when deployed performance deteriorates.

skills.name: Implement responsive layouts
skills.definition: Adapt layout and content to different viewport sizes.

skills.name: Use semantic HTML
skills.definition: Choose elements whose meaning matches the content and interaction.

skills.name: Handle asynchronous web requests
skills.definition: Handle successful responses, HTTP failures and request cancellation in the interface.

skills.name: Validate application inputs
skills.definition: Enforce input constraints and provide usable validation feedback on client and server.

skills.name: Enforce application authorization
skills.definition: Check permissions for protected actions and resources.

skills.name: Use database transactions
skills.definition: Commit related updates atomically and roll back unsuccessful operations.

skills.name: Improve existing software structure
skills.definition: Revise existing implementation while checking that required behaviour is preserved.

skills.name: Configure continuous integration
skills.definition: Run build and test steps automatically when code changes.

skills.name: Apply equivalence partitioning
skills.definition: Select representative cases from distinct valid and invalid input classes.

skills.name: Apply boundary value analysis
skills.definition: Test values at and around the boundaries of ordered input classes.

skills.name: Prioritise tests by risk
skills.definition: Order tests using failure likelihood and product impact.

skills.name: Prepare test data and environments
skills.definition: Set up controlled inputs and system conditions required for repeatable tests.

skills.name: Classify defect impact
skills.definition: Describe defect severity and propose a repair priority with evidence.

skills.name: Run regression tests
skills.definition: Check that changes have not broken previously working behaviour.

skills.name: Execute performance tests
skills.definition: Measure response behaviour under a defined workload and environment.

skills.name: Investigate flaky automated tests
skills.definition: Use retry results and controlled reruns to diagnose inconsistent test outcomes.
